response.text: {"summary":"A 6% food cost increase erodes margin and warrants selective price adjustments on the most impacted items to protect profitability.","actions":[{"title":"Identify which menu items have the highest food-cost percentage and lowest margin after the 6% increase","priority":"high"},{"title":"Raise prices on low-margin, high-volume items by 5-8% to offset cost increases","priority":"high"},{"title":"Negotiate with suppliers or source alternative vendors for the most expensive ingredients","priority":"medium"}]}
